notes.note: "In a pocket volume, price 7s. 6d. bound, a corrected edition of Charles Jones's Hoyle's Games Improved...from whom may be had, several of the above-mentioned games, printed in separate pamphlets."

741 note an 1813 edition with vi+492 pages. Jessel is quite specific, noting that it adds the games of Boston and Dutch Pins to the 1808 edition and goes on to record an 1814 edition which adds the game of Raffle. No copies of an 1813 edition are known to survive, including at the Bodleian Library which houses the Jessel collection. There is no hint of such a book in the Longman Archives, although the archives give a publication date of December 24, 1813 for this book. I have chosen not to include it in this bibliography.
